proposed_comments.title: Complete the WinUI window shell and lifecycle wiring
proposed_comments.body:
### Complete the WinUI window shell and lifecycle wiring

**Severity:** `high`

`MainWindow.xaml` currently declares only the content frame and loading ring while its code-behind expects the title bar and search box, and the generated XAML base types do not match the `WindowEx` code-behind for the main and snapshot windows. Align the XAML roots and code-behind, restore the search/back/title-bar controls, enforce the minimum size, preserve valid saved window placement, restore a minimized window on hotkey activation, and exit the WinUI dispatcher when the editor closes so the single-instance mutex is not left behind.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve workspace state during Launch & Edit recapture
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve workspace state during Launch & Edit recapture

**Severity:** `high`

The recapture path currently preserves only the workspace ID. It can reset the name, `MoveExistingWindows`, per-app command-line/elevation settings, and monitor ownership, then serialize new application positions against stale monitor metadata. Preserve those existing settings, replace the monitor snapshot with the recaptured configuration, re-parent retained applications, recover missing monitor numbers from window geometry, and regenerate the preview before saving.

proposed_comments.title: Restore the live preview and make capture overlays click-through
proposed_comments.body:
### Restore the live preview and make capture overlays click-through

**Severity:** `high`

The editing page still renders a placeholder instead of the calculated workspace preview, and `WS_EX_TRANSPARENT` only changes paint ordering; it does not make the opaque overlay strips return transparent hit tests. Bind the generated preview image into the editor, preserve hover highlighting, use the disabled DWM non-client policy value, and return `HTTRANSPARENT` from `WM_NCHITTEST` so the capture border cannot intercept clicks along monitor edges.

proposed_comments.title: Keep excluded apps restorable and prevent zero-app saves
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep excluded apps restorable and prevent zero-app saves

**Severity:** `high`

Disabling the whole app expander also disables its Add back action, while `CanBeSaved` counts excluded applications and can leave Save enabled after every app is removed. Disable only the editable settings, keep the remove/restore action enabled, require at least one included app before saving, and raise the save-validity notification whenever `IsIncluded` changes.

proposed_comments.title: Do not discard workspace data on a partial parse failure
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not discard workspace data on a partial parse failure

**Severity:** `high`

`SetWorkspaces` clears the live collection before every workspace has been parsed. A malformed entry can therefore leave the editor with a partial or empty in-memory list even though loading failed. Parse the entire payload into a temporary collection first and replace the live list only after all entries succeed; keep unit tests on an injected in-memory settings instance so validation never mutates the user's real sort preference.

proposed_comments.title: Finish the UI Automation and localization migration
proposed_comments.body:
### Finish the UI Automation and localization migration

**Severity:** `medium`

Several tests still target WPF class-name selectors or remain attached to the closed Snapshot Creator window, and some new Narrator names are hard-coded in English. Use stable WinUI automation IDs consistently, reattach to the editor after capture, make clean-profile and empty-state tests exercise the actual controls, localize accessible names through `.resw`, and keep the UI-test project in the normal solution/build path.
